items.title: Nurses, charities and MPs band together in continence campaign
items.summary: The Royal College of Nursing has joined with a group of leading charities to call for the NHS to put patients before price in purchasing decisions on continence care.

items.title: Market Engagement for Stoma Care Nurse Sponsorship Services
items.summary: East of England NHS collaborative Procurement Hub. EoECPH would like to approach the marketplace to gather market intelligence around a new framework for Stoma Care Nurse Sponsorship Services.
